description: Create a saved search (scout) from vehicle and filter criteria or a VIN pattern. Each request carries a creationRequestId from check_limits, so a matching retry returns the existing scout instead of a duplicate. Scouts check roughly every 24 hours and email a daily digest of new matches and price drops.

bodyStyles.description: Body styles. {includes, excludes} replaces only the supplied sides. An empty array clears that side. A plain array replaces includes only. Omitted sides stay unchanged.

colors.description: Exterior colors. {includes, excludes} replaces only the supplied sides. An empty array clears that side. A plain array replaces includes only. Omitted sides stay unchanged.

drivetrains.description: Drivetrains. {includes, excludes} replaces only the supplied sides. An empty array clears that side. A plain array replaces includes only. Omitted sides stay unchanged.

features.description: Features. {includes, excludes} replaces only the supplied sides. An empty array clears that side. A plain array replaces includes only. Omitted sides stay unchanged.

fuelTypes.description: Fuel types. {includes, excludes} replaces only the supplied sides. An empty array clears that side. A plain array replaces includes only. Omitted sides stay unchanged.

interiorColors.description: Interior colors. {includes, excludes} replaces only the supplied sides. An empty array clears that side. A plain array replaces includes only. Omitted sides stay unchanged.

keywords.description: Listing keywords. {includes, excludes} replaces only the supplied sides. An empty array clears that side. A plain array replaces includes only. Omitted sides stay unchanged.

maxDistanceMiles.description: Radius from the ZIP code, in miles

requestId.description: A creationRequestId issued by check_limits, valid for 24 hours. A retry with the same ID, name, and criteria returns the scout's current record; a different name or criteria, an expired ID, or a deleted scout returns a conflict.

transmissions.description: Transmissions. {includes, excludes} replaces only the supplied sides. An empty array clears that side. A plain array replaces includes only. Omitted sides stay unchanged.

trims.description: Allowed trims, such as XLE. Empty array clears this filter.

vehicleCombinations.description: Complete vehicle alternatives, using make, model, trims, startYear and endYear. Replaces the entire saved vehicle list. Cannot be combined with make/model/trims/yearMin/yearMax or vehicleIndex.

vin.description: VIN or VIN pattern with * wildcards; cannot combine with spec filters

name: create_scout

searchCriteria.description: All saved criteria, including nested vehicle combinations. Text fields are user-entered.
